snippet.title: BURIED BELOW – Official Cinematic Trailer | Horror Game
snippet.description:
- Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3651890/
- Discord, follow the development: https://discord.gg/nJzFGWExHQ

- Website: https://aurastudios.nl/
- Itch page: https://aurastudiosofficial.itch.io/
- Donate: https://ko-fi.com/aurastudios

—

An old tape replays your worst memory. Hoping to rid yourself of it once and for all, you step back into the moment. A camping trip, a fierce storm, and your girlfriend vanishing near an abandoned mine.

To follow her trail, you’ll need to scour the woods for tools to breach the sealed entrance. The mine holds unknown dangers, and something seems to roam the dark. Can you survive the depths and find her… or will the memory never end?

-

Currently being developed by Aura Studios | Justus
Survival Horror • Psychological • Atmospheric • Indie • Unreal engine
